name: 53560 · Mazomanie, WI
findings: ZIP 53560 (Mazomanie) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53560 (Mazomanie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53560 (Mazomanie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
